annotations.title: Sanctions Screen OFAC EU UK UN

description: Sanctions screening (OFAC, EU, UK, UN): is a company, organisation, vessel (name or IMO), aircraft or crypto wallet address sanctioned? Screens the official US OFAC SDN and Consolidated lists, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list and the UK Sanctions List, flagging UN Security Council designations, with fuzzy name and alias matching; returns matches, scores, programs and each list's date. Entities only, not individuals. Use for KYB, AML, vendor and pre-payment screening. Data lookup, not a compliance determination. Signed receipt. Price: $0.005 per call via x402 (USDC on Base or XRP on XRPL). The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict. Example arguments: {"name":"Huawei Technologies","lists":"all"}.

address.description: Crypto wallet address (checked against OFAC only; see also /v1/sanctions/address)

lists.description: Which lists: comma list of ofac, eu, uk, un, or all (default all). un = UN Security Council designations as carried in the UK and EU lists

name.description: Company, organisation, vessel or aircraft name to screen (give exactly one of name, imo, address). Entities only, not individuals

name: sanctions_screen

outputSchema.description: Paid result: { data, receipt }. Unpaid calls return an x402 PaymentRequired object instead (isError: true).

data.description: Sanctions matches with list (SDN, CONS, EU, UK), entry ID, type, programs, score, UN designation flag; plus each list's publish date and the lists screened

provenance.description: The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict.

receipt.description: Ed25519-signed, hash-chained receipt; verify free with the verify_receipt tool or POST /v1/verify-receipt. New receipts carry a signed `evidence` object: service_version, data_timestamp, validation, terms_version, terms_hash, provenance_hash.

title: Sanctions Screen OFAC EU UK UN
